prepare_the_damaged_area — VLM GRADING CRITERIA
Assess the completed damaged metal propeller blade area cleaned, measured and outlined for repair visible in the image. Evaluate each criterion independently as PASS or FAIL.

Criteria
1. Damage on the blade is surrounded by an open, unclosed dye or marker line
2. Outline is a jagged shape with sharp angular corners around the damage
3. Blade surface inside and around the outline is contaminated with visible grease, oil, and grit debris
4. Metal inside the outline shows deep gouges and distinct filing or sanding cuts
5. The finished work shows this defect: A crack extends from the damaged area.
6. The finished work shows this defect: Part of the damage lies outside the marked outline.
7. The finished work shows this defect: Marker or dye covers the damage, hiding it from inspection.

Overall decision
Overall PASS requires every required criterion to pass and no critical defect. Mark an unobservable required criterion “FAIL — not demonstrated in image.” Evaluate only visible evidence and do not infer hidden measurements, internal damage, torque, pressure, or test results.

blend_the_damage_out — VLM GRADING CRITERIA
Assess the completed blended and fine-sanded repair area on a metal propeller blade visible in the image. Evaluate each criterion independently as PASS or FAIL.

Criteria
1. Damaged area retains sharp corners or V-shaped notches within the depression
2. Blended area meets the surrounding blade surface at a prominent, abrupt step
3. Repair surface displays coarse file marks or gouges across the blended area
4. Raised lips, burrs, or torn metal project from the perimeter of the blend
5. The finished work shows this defect: A crack is visible in or beside the blended area.
6. The finished work shows this defect: Blend cuts across the full width of leading or trailing edge.
7. The finished work shows this defect: Blade is bent, gouged deeply, or shows a hole through the surface.

Overall decision
Overall PASS requires every required criterion to pass and no critical defect. Mark an unobservable required criterion “FAIL — not demonstrated in image.” Evaluate only visible evidence and do not infer hidden measurements, internal damage, torque, pressure, or test results.

clean_the_repair — VLM GRADING CRITERIA
Assess the completed cleaned and measured blend repair area on a metal propeller blade visible in the image. Evaluate each criterion independently as PASS or FAIL.

Criteria
1. Repair area is covered in fine metallic dust and sanding debris
2. Blended depression is visible on the blade, its surface showing a prominent scratch pattern of coarse filing
3. A steel scale or depth gauge is positioned entirely outside the repair area on the blade in frame
4. Blade surface around the repair shows solvent-smeared residue and loose rag fibers
5. The finished work shows this defect: A visible crack runs through or beside the blended area.
6. The finished work shows this defect: Blade edge is gouged or notched with a sharp, unblended step.
7. The finished work shows this defect: Loose metal filings or rag left resting on the blade.

Overall decision
Overall PASS requires every required criterion to pass and no critical defect. Mark an unobservable required criterion “FAIL — not demonstrated in image.” Evaluate only visible evidence and do not infer hidden measurements, internal damage, torque, pressure, or test results.
